selected.rationale: Delay on the basket-api->Redis edge makes every cart read/write block on cache latency; with no fallback or short timeout this stalls shopping cart calls and propagates unbounded latency to web/mobile clients.

Loss of the checkout integration event from Basket.API to RabbitMQ silently prevents Ordering.API from creating an order; Basket has no durable outbox/recovery, so checkout appears accepted but never processed.
Catalog is the hot read path for the webapp; injected delay makes product listing/browse calls hang and can saturate the webapp's HTTP client, exposing missing timeout and circuit breaker behavior.
Ordering API is called synchronously for order submission from the webapp; delay directly causes checkout timeouts/failures, revealing whether a bounded global timeout exists on the order path.
Loss on basket-api->Redis makes cart retrieval/update fail because Basket.API has no in-memory fallback, causing availability loss of the cart and preventing checkout for all sessions.
The mobile BFF depends on Catalog API for product data; delay in this edge adds latency to mobile app product pages and consumes BFF threads, exposing lack of per-call timeouts.
Loss on mobile BFF -> Ordering API turns order placement into intermittent 5xx/timeouts; without idempotent retry, user-submitted orders can be lost or duplicated.
Loss on catalog-api->RabbitMQ drops product/price change events, so baskets and integrations keep stale pricing; event bus delivery is not guaranteed, leading to silent data inconsistency.
